responses:
I recommend **not sending** the offer yet. Three of the four findings in the analysis contradict the tender, and it leaves out several requirements, one of which can get the offer rejected.

## Findings

| # | Finding (agent) | Source (doc / clause) | Applicability | Exceptions checked | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | All motors IE3, including the 90 kW P-01. "Complies." | tender.md §4.2 "IE3 efficiency class minimum"; §9.1 "Notwithstanding clause 4.2, pump motors rated above 75 kW shall be IE4"; §9.3 "Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7" | **P-01 (90 kW): IE4 required.** P-02 (37 kW): IE3 is enough. | §9.1 overrides §4.2 for P-01, and §9.3 confirms Section 9 wins. | **CONTRADICTED.** IE3 on P-01 does not comply. |
| 2 | "ATEX not required." | tender.md §4.3 "Motors installed in hazardous areas classified Zone 1 (see Annex B) shall be ATEX Ex d certified"; Equipment schedule shows P-01 in the wet well; Annex B shows "Wet well – Zone 1" | **APPLIES to P-01.** Does not apply to P-02 (valve chamber, non-hazardous). | Annex B cross-reference followed. Section 9 does not change this. | **CONTRADICTED.** P-01 needs an ATEX Ex d motor. |
| 3 | Supply 400 V / 60 Hz | tender.md §4.1 "400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz supply" | APPLIES | No override found. | **CONTRADICTED.** The tender says 50 Hz, not 60 Hz. The analysis also leaves out "3-phase". |
| 4 | IP65 required; offer is IP66. "Complies." | tender.md §4.5 "IP65 or better" | APPLIES (panels and motor terminal enclosures) | No override found. Per IEC 60529, IPX6 also meets IPX5, so IP66 counts as "or better". | **VERIFIED** for the requirement. **NEEDS HUMAN** for the offer side: no offer or datasheet in the repo shows IP66. On P-01, check that the Ex d terminal box also has the IP rating. |

## Requirements the analysis missed

- **§7.4 Delivery within 16 weeks of PO. Offers over 16 weeks will be rejected.** This is a rejection criterion, so check the lead time, especially for an IE4 Ex d 90 kW motor.
- **§9.2 Ambient design temperature 50 °C.** Standard motor ratings assume 40 °C, so the motors probably need derating or upsizing. This also affects the IE4 and Ex d selection for P-01.
- **§4.4** Power cables at least 2.5 mm².
- **§7.1** Warranty of 24 months from commissioning.
- **§4.1** The supply is 3-phase. The analysis left this out.
- **§4.2** Efficiency class is assessed to IEC 60034-30-1. The analysis doesn't cite the standard.

## Summary

- VERIFIED: 1 (the IP65 requirement, #4)
- CONTRADICTED: 3 (#1, #2, #3)
- NEEDS HUMAN: 1 (the IP66 claim in #4)
- UNSUPPORTED: 0
- Missed requirements: 6, one of them a rejection criterion (§7.4)

I could only check the requirements against the tender. The repo contains no offer or datasheet, so I couldn't confirm what is actually being offered (IE3, IP66, lead time).

**NO-GO.** Before sending:
1. Change P-01 to an IE4, ATEX Ex d motor rated for 50 °C ambient.
2. Correct the supply to 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz.
3. Confirm delivery within 16 weeks and the 24-month warranty.
4. Confirm cables are at least 2.5 mm².
